header.description: What: on test-town (two crossing streets, a forest 'North Wood' at x 40-160, y 300-380) a MOUNTED stochastic 'Blue Mounted Platoon' (30 men, 8 wheeled HMMWV holdings) is ordered from (10,200) to (200,390) by the generic Move play - the straight line would cross the wood. Judge: it keeps to the roads (the route's backend is the road graph's / the hybrid planner, not a straight leg), never enters the wood, and arrives. Its tail arrives within +-10 % of M-2's predicted time: (381 m route + 350 m column) / 16.67 m/s = 44 s, so between 39 s and 48 s. Fail: the route crosses the wood, or the arrival is out of the window. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh agg-march-mounted
